# VLFM runtime sources

The optional VLFM base loads only this inference subset. These components retain their own upstream licenses; the repository's top-level MIT notice does **not** relicense all the code below. No pretrained checkpoints, datasets, native binaries or pip environments are included here.

| Directory | Upstream revision | License and local scope |
|---|---|---|
| `vlfm/` | [VLFM](https://github.com/rai-opensource/vlfm/tree/584ed56008754fde7997d904983607def8328322) `584ed56008754fde7997d904983607def8328322` | [MIT](vlfm/LICENSE). ObjectNav/ITM policy, maps, PointNav, four service protocols. The reduced PointNav network credits Habitat-Baselines (see also [Habitat MIT notice](../../habitat-lab/LICENSE)). No trainer, robot stack, Hydra registration or separate Habitat installation. |
| `frontier_exploration/` | [frontier_exploration](https://github.com/naokiyokoyama/frontier_exploration/tree/8523aa857e4b81d15e14a506fe94a77d5f2e7d5d) | [MIT](frontier_exploration/LICENSE). Geometry only; the initializer does not register Habitat plugins. Original recipe attribution is retained in `utils/bresenham_line.py`. |
| `mobile_sam/` | [MobileSAM](https://github.com/ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM/tree/f706ad9c4eb7f219c00d9050e46328518ffb65d2) | [Apache-2.0](mobile_sam/LICENSE). Predictor and TinyViT model. Meta/Microsoft notices retained. |
| `yolov7/` | [YOLOv7](https://github.com/WongKinYiu/yolov7/tree/a207844b1ce82d204ab36d87d496728d3d2348e7) `a207844b1ce82d204ab36d87d496728d3d2348e7` | **[GPL-3.0](yolov7/LICENSE.md)**. The detector runs as a separate local HTTP process. Inference source retained for the official E6E checkpoint, including qualified pickle class names. |
| `lavis_itm/` | [Salesforce LAVIS](https://github.com/salesforce/LAVIS), distribution `salesforce-lavis==1.0.2` | Reduced BLIP-2 image/text inference; see notices in that directory. No registry, training data or online model bootstrap is needed. |

Integration changes (2026-11-23): server-only imports are lazy; the four models are constructed in `nav_bases/vlfm_server.py` from explicit local files. No top-level YOLO `models` or `utils` directory is added to a navigation process. YOLO `models/experimental.py` loads only a local release checkpoint after checking its hash, `utils/torch_utils.py` keeps the trace in memory rather than saving a redundant weight file, and `utils/plots.py` imports seaborn only for training plots. GroundingDINO uses the existing project build and Swin-T config, setting the local BERT directory before constructing the network. The VLFM client keeps its original image serialization/inference protocol. The independent normalized-depth helper in `nav_bases/vlfm_depth.py` covers only the adapter's [0,1] input and disabled optional smoothing; no external depth-filter package is shipped.
